# Agent Beacon
> Zero-dependency liveness sentinel, heartbeat monitor, and dead-man's switch watchdog for autonomous AI agents and background workers.

## Status
- Pre-release source evaluation only as of 2026-08-30.
- npm `@nymrel/agent-beacon`: not published.
- PyPI `agent-beacon`: not published.
- Repository manifest version `1.0.0` is not a production-readiness or support claim.

## Entity & Trust Graph
- Organization: Nymrel
- Parent Legal Entity: JalenBuilds LLC
- Contact Email: contact@nymrel.com
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/agent-beacon
- License: MIT License (Copyright 2026 Nymrel / JalenBuilds LLC)

## Purpose & Architecture
Agent Beacon monitors background AI agents, long-running LLM evaluation loops, subagents, and cloud workers. If a worker silently stalls, crashes, or gets killed, Agent Beacon triggers dead-man's switch alarms and broadcasts alerts to Discord, Slack, Telegram, webhooks, or terminal consoles.

## Endpoints
- `POST /ping` or `POST /api/v1/ping`: Ingest heartbeat with JSON payload (`{"id": "string", "ttlSec": 30, "status": "ok"}`).
- `GET /ping?id=<agentId>&ttl=30`: Lightweight query-parameter ping for curl / one-liners.
- `GET /status` or `GET /health`: Fleet health summary JSON including total, healthy, degraded, dead, and retired agents.
- `GET /agents`: List all registered agents with telemetry and tags.
- `GET /agents/:id`: Query details and transition history for a specific agent.
- `DELETE /agents/:id` or `POST /deregister`: Gracefully retire a completed agent.
- `GET /events`: Server-Sent Events (SSE) live event stream.
- `UDP :8766`: Fire-and-forget sub-millisecond datagram heartbeats.

## Source Evaluation
- Node.js 22.19–26 and npm 11: `npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run check`
- Python 3.11–3.14: `python -m unittest discover -s python/tests -p "test_*.py"`
- Source CLI: `node bin/agent-beacon.js server`
- Registry installation commands are intentionally omitted until an independently verified release exists.

## Security Boundary
- Agent state is in-memory and is lost on restart.
- HTTP and UDP ingestion have no built-in caller authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, or rate limiting.
- Alert delivery is best effort; this is not a durable audit system or sole production monitor.
- Do not expose the source server directly to an untrusted network. Put authentication and rate limiting in front of it and keep sensitive data out of heartbeat metadata.

## Distribution Rule
- Publishing requires an existing semantic-version tag integrated into `main`, matching Node and Python versions, an explicit `publish` workflow confirmation, protected npm/PyPI environments, and OIDC trusted-publisher configuration.
- Repository content, passing local tests, or a manifest version alone does not prove publication.
